summary.description: One sentence, two at most, on the state of the changes. Never a description of them.

path.description: File path relative to the repository root.

start_line.description: First line it is about, in the new version of the file.

end_line.description: Last line it is about: the first again for one line.

body.description: At most three short sentences: what is wrong, why it matters, the fix. Markdown.

reopened.description: One entry for each earlier finding resolved fixed whose problem is still present.

thread.description: The earlier finding's thread, such as 3.2.

reason.description: One or two sentences on why the problem remains.
